main.description: Membership of one reference in one collection. A separate record (not an array on either side) so a reference can join many collections without being rewritten, and so adds/removes are cheap single-record writes. Same shape as app.bsky.graph.listitem.

note.description: Why this paper is in THIS collection: 'cite for the baseline comparison', 'reviewer 2 asked for this'. Distinct from a reading note, which is not collection-specific.

sections.description: Manuscript sections where this will be cited, e.g. ['intro', 'related-work']. Turns a flat bibliography into an outline and makes 'which references are not yet cited anywhere' answerable.

citeKeyOverride.description: Collection-local citekey, for when a co-author's existing .bib already uses a different key for this work.

sortKey.description: Opaque fractional-index string for manual ordering. Fractional (not integer) so reordering one item is one write, not N.
